args.subject: Refund Confirmation: Invoice C-9377 (Conversion Loss)
args.body:
Dear Adatum Team,

We have processed a refund of **120** for invoice C-9377 due to an incorrect currency billing (initially invoiced in the wrong currency). The refund reflects the conversion loss as per your contract (EUR).

**Refund Details:**
- Amount: 120
- Reason: Wrong currency application (EUR → misapplied currency)
- Status: Processed

Thank you for your patience. If you have any further questions, reply to this email or contact our support team.

Regards,
IT Operations Team
